name: T cell signaling and activation-induced cell death
rationale: All members concern T cell receptor signaling and its alloimmune or Fas-mediated activation-induced death outcome, setting the theme apart from the Treg/Th-differentiation confusables (C1, C2) and the generic death-receptor apoptosis confusables (C3, C4).

name: Viral receptor attachment and endocytic entry into host cells
rationale: Members describe virus attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and transport (dengue, influenza, RSV) plus their positive regulation, unlike confusables centered on host restriction (C1), fusion-based entry (C2, C3) or viral protein maturation (C4).

qualifier: nephron progenitor proliferation, survival and organ size control
name: Early kidney development and nephron progenitor growth control
rationale: All members concern nephric duct/ureteric bud/metanephric development, and the theme uniquely carries regulation of progenitor maintenance, proliferation, apoptosis and kidney size, whereas confusables focus on ureteric bud branching or mesenchymal-epithelial differentiation.

name: Protein aggregate autophagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, aggresome assembly and misfolded protein response, and only this theme includes stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly, which confusables (ERAD, protein QC, pexophagy) lack.

name: Catecholamine transport and norepinephrine transporter uptake
rationale: All members concern monoamine/catecholamine transport, and norepinephrine uptake with SLC6A2 deficiency distinguishes it from confusables built on dopamine transporter defects, dopamine synthesis or vesicular loading.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization control
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast expansion/differentiation (including Wnt) and bone mineralization, distinguishing them from the chondrocyte/RUNX2 confusables (C1, C3) and osteoclast/resorption confusables (C2, C4).

core: Monocyte and neutrophil innate immune activation
name: Monocyte and neutrophil signature with neutrophil degranulation
rationale: Members are blood monocyte/neutrophil/myeloid signatures plus degranulation, inflammatory response and complement receptor signaling, whereas confusables emphasize respiratory burst, formyl peptide or Fc receptor signaling and tissue macrophage programmes.

qualifier: histone and non-histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone protein methylation and demethylation
rationale: All members concern methylation marks (lysine mono/dimethylation, arginine methylation, MLL/WDR5 complexes, histone demethylases, p53 methylation, DNA methylation), unlike confusables built on chromatin remodelers/HDACs or PRC2-imprinting silencing.

name: Oncogenic ERBB2 and EGFR variant signaling and drug resistance
rationale: Every member is constitutive signaling or inhibitor resistance of ERBB2/EGFR cancer variants, distinguishing it from wild-type ERBB adaptor signaling (C1) and from FGFR/PDGFR/ALK oncogenic mutant confusables.

name: mRNA 3'-end polyadenylation and transcript stabilization against decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, export, decapping and stabilizing inhibition of mRNA decay, whereas confusables center on histone mRNA processing, deadenylation and ARE- or miRNA-mediated destabilization.

core: Response to metal ions and oxidative stress
name: Metal-induced oxidative stress with heme oxygenase and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to lead, cobalt, mercury, selenium and iron with HMOX1/BACH1 regulation, peroxide control and ferroptosis, which the cadmium, iron-transport and metallothionein confusables lack.

name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux limiting macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol import/efflux, lipoprotein transport and storage under LXR control and inhibit foam cell formation, distinguishing them from HDL assembly, LDL receptor uptake and SREBP biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: phase II conjugation and thiopurine methylation
name: Xenobiotic phase II conjugation and thiopurine methylation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic/toxin detoxification via methylation, sulfonation and acetylation, including TPMT/azathioprine, whereas confusables are dominated by CYP/FMO oxidative phase I metabolism and mycotoxins.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism in ammonium handling
rationale: Members concern glutamate/glutamine/aspartate/arginine metabolism with ammonium homeostasis and nitrogen utilization, distinguished from the urea cycle disorders (C1), proline/glyoxylate (C2), malate-aspartate shuttle (C3) and alanine/gluconeogenesis (C4).

name: Nucleotide deamination editing, antiviral restriction and translational repression
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC deamination editing, APOBEC3G and other host restriction of viral replication, and translational repression/frameshifting, unlike confusables on HIV life cycle, DNA demethylation/repair or coronavirus replication.

name: Kinase inhibitor resistance of ALK mutants
rationale: All members are ALK mutants resistant to specific TKIs, distinguishing it from confusables on TKI binding, FGFR/PDGFR/KIT/FLT3 mutant signaling and fusions.

name: Vascular endothelial and platelet adhesion signatures
rationale: Most members are endothelial, perivascular, platelet/megakaryocyte and myeloid adhesion modules plus endothelial adhesion/morphogenesis terms (a B-cell TBA module and glucocorticoid targets fit poorly), distinct from stromal fibroblast, smooth muscle and motif-based confusables.

qualifier: acetylation, glutamylation, folding and microtubule severing
name: Tubulin folding, acetylation and glutamylation in microtubule remodeling
rationale: Members cover tubulin folding, protein acetylation, polyglutamylation/deglutamylation and microtubule severing/depolymerization, distinguishing them from chaperonin folding (C2), histone acetylation (C3) and cilia/sperm axoneme confusables.

name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and intra-Golgi traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, positioning, mitotic disassembly/reassembly and intra-Golgi/retrograde COPI traffic, while confusables cover only vesicle budding, membrane tubulation or Golgi retention.

name: ER-Golgi vesicle targeting and COPI retrograde budding
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting between ER exit sites and Golgi plus COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, distinguishing them from tethering (C1) and COPII anterograde/ER quality-control confusables.

name: Prostate gland epithelial development and growth
rationale: All members concern prostate gland growth, acinus morphogenesis and glandular epithelial differentiation, distinguishing it from mammary, salivary and pancreatic gland development confusables.

qualifier: thymocyte expansion and B cell differentiation
name: Early lymphoid development: thymocyte expansion and B cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate hematopoietic progenitor, pro-B and B cell differentiation and immature thymocyte proliferation/survival, whereas confusables emphasize thymic selection, mature T cell activation or bone marrow cell homeostasis.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and homolog synapsis
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation/repair, recombination resolution, synaptonemal complex, telomere attachment and prophase checkpoints, unlike confusables on meiotic cohesion, segregation, spindle and spermatogenesis.

core: Fatty acid and organic acid catabolism
name: Fatty acid catabolism including peroxisomal branched-chain alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members cover short/medium/long-chain fatty and organic acid catabolism plus phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, which mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine and BCAA confusables lack.

qualifier: FRS, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
name: FGFR downstream FRS, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 adaptor cascades (FRS, SHC, PI3K, PLC-gamma) and Klotho-dependent activation, while confusables cover FGFR isoform ligand binding, point mutants and feedback regulation.
